name: synapse
description: Connect Claude to the Futures Platform Synapse app via FP MCP for foresight, trends, signals, and scenarios.

FP_MCP_URL.title: FP MCP URL
FP_MCP_URL.description: HTTP MCP endpoint for Futures Platform Synapse.

FP_MCP_AUTH_SCHEME.title: FP MCP auth scheme
FP_MCP_AUTH_SCHEME.description: Prefix before the token in the Authorization header (e.g. Bearer). Leave empty to send only the token.

FP_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.title: FP MCP bearer token
FP_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.description: Secret token for FP MCP. Sent as Authorization: <auth scheme> <token> (default scheme Bearer).
